title: Ignore OS metadata and Git-ignored files in evaluation source identity
goal: Only files that are part of the source decide whether a recorded evaluation run still covers it
acceptance: A committed test fails before the fix for a .DS_Store, a Thumbs.db and a Git-ignored file
An untracked file that Git does not ignore still changes the source identity
The built web bundle is still hashed when includeBuild is set
escalation: A change to what counts as source for model qualification goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: a filter and one regression test. Not a measurement.
